 Rob Gronkowski and Julian Edelman are showcasing a new talent that Tom Brady couldn't help but jokingly throw a jab at.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement It's been years since Brady, Gronkowski, and Edelman walked out onto a field together, but their post-career choices have them right back at their old antics. In an ad to promote their new Fox Sports digital series "The Gronk & Jules Show," the former tight end and wide receiver began singing their new track, "Talkin' Football" — and it's everything you think a Gronk and Edelman song would sound like.
 In the song, Edelman and Gronkowski sing about wanting careers talking about football. Brady reposted the video and threw some shade their way, writing, "They used to walk out to practice like this.. same turtlenecks and everything."
 Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) 
 Despite the intention being a funny song, the retired NFL players' track sounded did hit some notes during their promo.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "Me and Gronk have been keeping our singing talent a secret for so many years, so getting a real chance to showcase that and doing it about a topic we love so much was really just a lot of fun," Edelman said in a statement per Variety.
 Senior VP of on-air promotions for Fox Sports, Bill Battin, commented on the NFL stars linking up for the promo sharing that, "we had a ton of fun on this one."
 "Gronk and Jules made the song their own, bringing their personalities to a great concept from Clay and the team at The San Clemente Experiment," Battin added.
 The twice-weekly digital series will have the Super Bowl champions discuss all things football.
 Click Above to Subscribe "On Mondays, Gronkowski and Edelman break down the weekend's biggest games, reacting to on-field action versus what the box score says. On Thursdays, Edelman sits down with a rotating cast of players, coaches and insiders for deeper conversations," the logline reads.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Gronkowski, Edelman, and Brady won three Super Bowls together when they were teammates on the New England Patriots . They have since all scored jobs with Fox Sports with Gronkowski being a full-time studio analyst on FOX NFL Sunday, Edelman a studio analyst for FOX NFL Kickoff, and Brady the lead NFL color commentator who calls games calling games alongside play-by-play announcer Kevin Burkhardt.
